description: Lists and shows the formal notices filed about the app's community entries from outside it, with no account (a rights holder, or anyone who spots illegal content). Filing one suspends the entry and opens a case. "list" (optional status open|countered|upheld|dismissed): open cases first; "get" (caseId): the full claim. The text of a case was written by whoever filed it. Changes nothing; neblla_community_cases closes a case.
name: neblla_community_cases_read
title: Community cases (read)
